Beautifully Delicious!
Dec 2024 • Solo
Hoi An Dining Advice - The beauty and uniqueness of Hoi An Ancient Town is common knowledge, a place that can not be missed when in Vietnam. What many people do not know is the in the very heart of the Old Town, where wooden traditional houses are built hugging one another, fee modern dining venues are offering an upscale emotional journey to travelers. 
LIM DINING ROOM - @limdiningroom - is the perfect example of this. In a extremely beautifully decorated old house, with minimalism and excellent taste, in the very heart of the pedestrian path, this restaurant offers a delicious Mediterranean cuisine, professional service, well built wine card and unforgettable memories.

Our A la Carte picks:

- Welcome Bread&Butter.

- Beef Carpaccio “Carne Salada’’ with Parmigiano Reggiano Cheese and Extra Virgin Olive Oil.

- Focaccia with Cherry Tomatoes, Garlic oil, Rosemary & Parmigiano.

- Spinach & Ricotta Ravioli, Sage, Butter, Lemon & Parmigiano.

- Chocolate Dream, Trio of Chocolate: Mousse, Ice Cream and Moist Chocolate Cake.

We have dined several times at Lim Dining Room, trying different dishes and wines, and every single time we had a great dining experience that left us positively impressed with the inner desire to be back as soon as possible. Highly suggested!
